questions.stem_text:
Even if the United States is at a comparative disadvantage in agriculture, why might it
still be more efficient for the United States to specialize in agricultural production?

options.A: Due to the availability of advanced agricultural technology
options.C: Due to increasing demand for agricultural products
options.D: Due to decreasing costs (increasing returns to scale)

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Due to decreasing costs (increasing returns to scale)

questions.stem_text: What are the major forms of money in use?

options.C: Paper money, barter systems, digital wallets
options.E: Digital currencies, credit cards, mobile payments

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Gold, silver, bronze

questions.stem_text: A likely cause of falling Treasury bond prices might be

options.A: an increase in private sector investment.
options.D: fiscal policy designed to reduce the budget deficit.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - contractionary monetary policy.

questions.stem_text: A monopsonist is identified by one of the following:

options.A: A wage payment lower than the average revenue product of labor.
options.B: Employment level lower than that of a competitive labor market.
options.C: A single buyer of labor services.
options.D: Employment level greater than that of a competitive labor market.
options.E: A wage payment lower than the marginal revenue product of labor.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - A wage payment lower than the marginal revenue product of labor.
